description: "Use when writing SDLC markdown artifacts such as requirements, architecture, design reviews, implementation plans, verification notes, PR preparation notes, and changelog entries."
name: "SDLC Artifact Writing"
applyTo: "*.md"
---

# SDLC Artifact Rules

- Keep artifacts concise, professional, and traceable to [docs/user-story.md](../../docs/user-story.md).
- Mark phase status clearly when work is pending, blocked, or awaiting human approval.
- Never claim a test, approval, review, PR, or external action happened unless it actually happened.
- Call out scope creep explicitly instead of silently expanding the plan.
